title: Vengeance
note: Blizzard's order from conversation.json (trigger groups as listed, lines by conversationOrder).

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Look at what Arthas left in his wake. How many more cities will he burn? How many lives will he claim?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Rivendare is the one who set this in motion. We're going to end him here and now.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Indeed. The city will be well fortified, but I can enter the side gate and raise the portcullises.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: A sound plan. Stay safe until we can regroup with you.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: And you, Garek. May the Light guide your blade.

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: The cowardly mages of the Kirin Tor spurned my talent and ambition. But the Lich King will reward it!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: I now cast aside this wretched flesh and blood, and embrace the immortality of undeath!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Behold! I arise anew, perfected in form and power!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Leonid! Tell my students to do as they wish. A greater destiny awaits me now!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Rivendare! You will answer for your crimes with your death!

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Death? What do you know of death?

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: I have seen and wielded its true power! The Lich King has exalted me above foolish weaklings like you!

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Now I will draw the screams out of you, as I did with your pathetic captain!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You don't deserve to speak his name! Die like the vermin you are! For Landen!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text:
Crates of grain, infected with the plague. This is how Rivendare 
doomed his people.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate is locked. We’ll have to wait for Ilastar to open it.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The way is open. I will remain up here and scout ahead.

lines.speaker: Mortar Team
lines.text: Are you... alive? Thank the Light! We’ve been surrounded by the Scourge for weeks!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Focus on the Crypt, before it makes short work of us!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Ilastar, how do you fare?

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Well enough. I will heal you as best as I can from up here.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Alonsus Chapel. What sacrilege have the cult inflicted upon it?

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I can’t face them alone. Garek’s mortar teams can help from afar.

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Reinforcements! I told ye we just had to hang on a little longer!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate’s still closed. There must be a second lever.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The gate remains shut. There must be another lever.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gates are open! Frostwhisper will taste our steel!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gates are open! Frostwhisper will taste our steel!

lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: You've saved my life! I need to get out of here!

lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: Thank you, kind sir! I thought I would die in there, or worse!

lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: Can it be? Is the nightmare over? I can't thank you enough!

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: The streets are infested with the undead. Best avoid them if we can.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Here they come! Be ready to fight!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The gate’s locked. We won’t get through without a key.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: The road to Crusader’s Square is open. Rivendare can’t hide forever.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It was a demon! Wings and horns and cloven feet!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Stratholme was one of the greatest cities in Lordaeron. Then Rivendare sacrificed it to the undead!

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: He is but one of many to sell his soul to the Scourge. They will all burn in holy fire.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Damn, our forces have been split. We need to find the lever that opens the gate.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Let's regroup and press forward.

lines.speaker: Knight
lines.text: More survivors! Hold the line!

lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: We're trapped! Please, help us!

lines.speaker: Citizen
lines.text: Death to Lordaeron!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Such is the fate of all cultists.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Here is the profane tower where Rivendare holds court.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I’ll throw him from the parapets once I’ve cut him down.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Garek, there could still be survivors throughout the city.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Our soldiers can keep searching for civilians in need of rescue.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We’ll regroup in Hearthglen when the deed is done. Now, let’s bring Rivendare to justice.

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: To arms!

lines.speaker: Sorceress
lines.text: Now victory shall be ours!

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: It's only a flesh wound...

lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: I come to cleanse this land.

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Locked and loaded!

lines.speaker: Mortar Team
lines.text: Let's get to fightin'!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: Ah, back for more, are you? This time I will flay you alive!

lines.speaker: Ras Frostwhisper
lines.text: You cannot kill me so easily, mortals. We will meet again.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Forget about him. Our true target is Rivendare.

lines.speaker: Lorthiras
lines.text: Your suffering will be exquisite.

lines.speaker: Lorthiras
lines.text: This is not the end, little mortals.

lines.speaker: Grimthane
lines.text: Your bones will serve the Scourge.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Now your bones can join the rest.

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: You will all serve me!

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: The Scourge's numbers are endless! You will drown in your own blood!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What... is this? It's in my lungs...

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Plague spores... we... we're infected...

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Annoying pests! Witness true power!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Ilastar, the obelisks! Destroy them!

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: I... can't...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hold on, Ilastar!

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: By the Light! The spores from those mushrooms are spreading the plague. They cannot be allowed to grow!

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: Let these vile spores choke on the ashes of this ruined city.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It looks like some tried to flee Stratholme by sea. The cult must have sunk their ship.

lines.speaker: Ilastar
lines.text: We should recover their supplies. They can aid the war effort.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Those should be enough supplies. Time to get back to land.
